subject: Incident verification - confirm your account
body: A security incident was detected on the network and a subset of accounts requires verification to confirm they were not part of the breach. Your account is in that subset. To verify, please reply with your username and the answer to your security question. This allows us to confirm your identity before releasing your account from the hold. The verification must be completed within one hour. Do not attempt to change your password during this time, as it will conflict with the verification process. An analyst will follow up once the check is complete.
hook: Weaponizes a security incident and analyst urgency to extract both username and security answers.
